relationships.subject: cannabidiol
relationships.evidence_quote: administration of CBD, but not CBG, on Day 6 reversed mechanical sensitivity following oxaliplatin exposure

relationships.subject: CB2
relationships.evidence_quote: All three antagonists dose dependently attenuated CBG’s effect

relationships.subject: cannabigerol
relationships.evidence_quote: CBG and CBD decreased naloxone-precipitated jumping behavior alone and acted synergistically in combination

relationships.subject: cannabigerol
relationships.evidence_quote: CBG attenuated the acute antinociceptive effects of morphine and CBD

key_findings: CBG reversed oxaliplatin mechanical sensitivity only on Days 4-6 dosing, blocked by α2, CB1 or CB2 antagonists; CBD effective more broadly.
CBG and CBD were synergistic against naloxone-precipitated withdrawal; CBG attenuated morphine antinociception.
